title: Sunrise yoga
short: Slow practice on the ocean deck as the first fishing boats come home.
long: Our teachers lead an unhurried hatha session on a raised timber deck above the beach. The practice follows the light: gentle movement in the blue hour, breathing as the sun clears the horizon, and stillness to finish with king coconut water.

title: Private dining
short: A table set on the sand, lit by lanterns, with a menu cooked for you.
long: Choose your setting: on the beach at low tide, in a lantern-lit corner of the garden, or on your own veranda. Our chefs build a menu around the day's catch and your tastes, served course by course as the light fades.

title: Ocean excursions
short: Early boat trips from Mirissa to look for blue whales and spinner dolphins.
long: Between December and April, the waters off Mirissa are among the best places in the world to see blue whales. We arrange small-group trips with operators who follow responsible whale-watching guidelines, keeping distance and limiting time near the animals.

title: Turtle nesting walks
short: Quiet night walks at Rekawa beach, where sea turtles come ashore to nest.
long: Rekawa, just east of Tangalle, is one of Sri Lanka's most important turtle nesting beaches. Community guides lead small groups to watch from a respectful distance, without flash photography or torches, as turtles come ashore.

title: Local culture
short: The cave temples of Mulkirigala, village markets and a lesson in southern cooking.
long: Climb the rock-cut steps of Mulkirigala, an ancient Buddhist cave temple with centuries-old murals, then walk through a village market with our chef to choose spices for a cooking lesson back at the resort. Please dress modestly for temple visits.

title: Wellness rituals
short: Treatments inspired by Sri Lankan traditions, using oils pressed from the garden.
long: In a pavilion screened by bamboo, therapists combine warm herbal oils, coconut and gentle massage in rituals inspired by local traditions. Treatments are for relaxation only and are not medical therapy.
